observations: Free-standing cooker with a glass top lid.
The cooktop features 4 gas burners and 2 electric hotplates.
The brand 'IXAM' is visible on the front control panel and on a sticker on the oven door.
There are seven control knobs on the front panel.
The appliance appears to be sitting on its original cardboard shipping base.
Blue protective film is visible on the stainless steel/metal surfaces.
The oven door has a large glass window.
A Hisense freezer box is visible in the background.
